data.title: Green Acres
data.about:
Conceptualized and designed for families, the villas at Green Acres are situated next to a 4 million square feet green park. the lush greenery with a tranquil environment, just perfect for when you want to relax and unwind.

This entire project aims to market a healthy and active lifestyle. For an equivalent reason, the amenities and facilities on offer are primed to enrich your changing lifestyle preferences. Moreover, the seamless design of the homes and therefore the fusion of trendy interiors with high-quality fittings and furnishings, it’ll surely enhance the standard of your living standards.

Green Acres Villas offering great views of the encompassing areas which of the skyline, the event also happens to be a part of a master-planned community. Surrounded by many first-class dining, retail, entertainment, and leisure venues, additionally, to colleges and healthcare clinics, you’re unlikely to check out of place.

A ready community located within Dubailand, Damac Hills is a beautiful and unparalleled place to live. It is a popular choice amongts residents and investors because of its idyllic green surroundings. Covering an entire area of 42 million square feet, Damac Hills offers a variety of homes to choose from, including Green Acers, the greenest home sin Damac Hills.
